caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object composed of multiple flat, rectangular pieces of wood assembled together. The base is a thick plank with rounded and slightly beveled corners, showing visible wood grain and a worn, slightly concave surface in the center. Attached to the back edge of the base is a vertical panel, and another thinner plank extends horizontally above part of the base, supported at its sides by two vertical end pieces, forming a partial enclosure or shelf. The wood is light brown with darker lines and knots, and the edges are worn and chipped in places. A single round metal fastener is visible near one edge of the base. The background is plain and uncolored, and there is a small block of text with a name or signature in the bottom left corner.
title: Scouring Board
